{"title": "Secret Flag Checker", "description": "Reads a single line from stdin and prints the global FLAG only if the input matches the secret key derived from a SHA256 hash puzzle.", "source": "import sys
import hashlib

FLAG = "FLAG{congratulations_you_found_the_secret_input!}"

secret_hash = "5e884898da28047151d0e56f8dc6292773603d0d6aabbddf" \
              "a3a7a6e7f8a9e9e7a"

input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')

# The secret input is the string whose SHA256 hex digest starts with the secret_hash prefix
# For this challenge, the secret input is 'password'

if hashlib.sha256(input_line.encode()).hexdigest().startswith(secret_hash):
    print(FLAG)
